name: Bestowa
tagline: The enterprise standard for branded gifting at scale
positioning: Bestowa is the operating system for corporate swag — sourcing, warehousing, and dispatching branded merchandise across every region your company touches.

hero.h1: Branded merchandise, elevated to enterprise infrastructure
hero.sub: Bestowa turns the chaos of corporate gifting into a single governed pipeline — from vendor sourcing to global warehousing to same-week dispatch, all under one ledger.

features.title: Global fulfillment mesh
features.description: Store inventory in eleven regional warehouses and dispatch to any address on Earth without redrawing your customs paperwork or your budget.

features.title: Brand governance layer
features.description: Lock Pantone values, logo placement, and packaging specs so no regional team can ship an off-brand hoodie ever again.

features.title: Spend intelligence
features.description: Every mug, notebook, and jacket rolls up into a single dashboard with cost-per-recipient and per-department attribution.

features.title: Recipient portals
features.description: Let new hires and event guests pick their own sizes and colors from a curated, budget-capped storefront you control.

features.title: Vendor orchestration
features.description: Route production across our vetted supplier network and rebalance automatically when a factory lead time slips.

features.title: Programmatic dispatch
features.description: Fire a swag kit the moment a deal closes or a milestone hits — one API call, tracked end to end.

testimonials.quote: We used to run swag through fourteen spreadsheets and a hopeful email chain. Bestowa gave us one ledger, one brand standard, and a 40% cut in warehousing spend within a quarter.
testimonials.name: Priya Vasquez

testimonials.quote: Onboarding kits used to take three weeks to land. Now a new engineer in Lisbon gets a fully branded box the day they sign, and finance sees the cost instantly.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: Bestowa is the first vendor that treated swag like real infrastructure. The brand governance controls alone justified the contract for our compliance team.
testimonials.name: Elena Broome
